And it is not fit that mortal should wed with the Elf-kin.”’ ““Yet we have some part in that kinship,” said Aragorn, “‘if the tale of my forefathers is true that I have learned.” ““Tt is true,” said Gilraen, “but that was long ago and in another age of this world, before our race was diminished. Therefore I am afraid; for without the good will of Master Elrond the Heirs of Isildur will soon come to an end. But I do not think that you will have the good will of Elrond in this matter.” ‘““Then bitter will my days be, and I will walk in the wild alone,” said Aragorn. “
